Aurora: Widely used and up-to-date dashboard with a homebrew store and clean cover art.
Freestyle: The OG of custom 360 dashboards. Excellent customization and skinning options.
IngeniouX: An older, outdated dashboard with FTP and minimal skin customization.
Viper360: A very early and basic executables launcher and file manager.
FFPlay: Standard homebrew media player with up to 720p support.
GOD.Unlocker: Utility for unlocking Games on Demand containers.
HDDx.Fixer: Quick utility for setting up HDDx for Xbox Original support.
NXE2GOD: Play installed GoD games without the disc.
XeXMenu: The classic file manager and executables launcher.
CipherLive: Client package for the CipherLive Xbox Live stealth service.
Infinite: Client package for the Infinite Xbox Live stealth service.
TetheredLive: Client package for the TetheredLive Xbox Live stealth service.
XbGuard: Client package for the XbGuard Xbox Live stealth service.
XBL.Kyuubi: Client package for the XBL.Kyuubi Xbox Live stealth service.
XBLKyuubi: Client package for the XBLKyuubi Xbox Live stealth service.
XBLS: Xbox Live stealth service client package.
xbNetwork: Client package for the xbNetwork Xbox Live stealth service.
